nodes.text: India reported its first Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) case in an 8-month-old in Bengaluru on January 6. The Baptist Hospital detected it, though the state health lab didn't test the sample. DGHS Dr. Atul Goel said HMPV causes flu-like symptoms, mainly in young and elderly. https://t.co/6XY9zUB2Yl
